metadata.keyword_policy_details: two body slots then one context slot; dedup by chunk ID; up to 2x index reads, unchanged returned budget and native chosen-hit score
metadata.scope: Isolated corpus; real HTTP API, auth, parsing, persistence, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch and Ollama embeddings; only search and RAG workers; no graph or answer evaluation.
metadata.warmup: One untimed request per mode after corpus indexing; one measured pass per mode/K.
metadata.ranking_unit: Deduplicate the first API TopK candidates by document; no extra candidate fetch. Evidence checks inspect all returned TopK contents.
